headline: The Operating System for Chemical Labs
title: ChemInventory: Chemical Inventory Management System
tagline: Chemical inventory, orders and batch documents in one app.
description: ChemInventory is a chemical inventory management system. Track chemical inventory, orders, contacts and batch documents in one app.

screenshot.alt: The Inventory page of the app. A table lists ten chemical batches with product number, batch number, name, CAS number, location and quantity.

features.title: Inventory by batch
features.statement: Track each batch by CAS number, location, quantity and unit. Search, sort and filter the list.

screenshot.alt: The Inventory page with the Filters panel open. A list of locations shows under the Location filter.

features.title: Stock ledger
features.statement: Record purchases, sales, usage, disposal and corrections. Split a batch and keep the link to its parent.

screenshot.alt: The Transactions page with the type filter open. It lists Purchase, Sale, Usage, Disposal, Opening Balance, Correction and Batch Split.

features.title: Orders and contacts
features.statement: Follow orders through partial deliveries and payments. Import or export orders as CSV. Keep contacts with people and addresses.

screenshot.alt: The Orders page. Each row shows the contact, direction, status, quantity left and expected delivery date. Buttons offer Download CSV, Import Orders and Add Order.

features.title: Batch and order documents
features.statement: Attach COA, specification, GC, NMR, HPLC and IR files to a batch, and quotes, POs and invoices to an order.

screenshot.alt: The Batch Documents dialog for one batch. The document type list shows Internal COA, Specification, Supplier COA, GC, NMR, HPLC and IR.

features.title: History and dashboard
features.statement: See who changed inventory, transactions and orders, and when. Open a dashboard of counts and trends by area.

screenshot.alt: The Audit Log page. A Change History table lists the date, user, source, record, action and details of each change.

features.title: Roles and price privacy
features.statement: Give each person an Admin, Manager or Chemist role, enforced on the server. Chemists do not see prices.

screenshot.alt: The User Permissions dialog for the Chemist role. Manage Inventory is granted. Transaction ledger, commercial details, user management and audit log access are not granted.

agentsMayNot: book meetings or send messages for a user
